Perfect For…  
Map-based infographics are exceptionally valuable for real estate listings of lot/land, or any listing where its location or relative proximity carries substantial value. They're also great for properties too large for a drone to capture in a single image.

Consider using them for:

Farms/Ranches – Illustrating acreage, access points, water sources, outbuildings, and proximity to markets or other farms

Commercial Properties – Showing proximity to transportation hubs, other businesses, customer base, zoning information, and traffic patterns

Development Sites – Visualizing potential layouts, access to utilities, surrounding amenities, and zoning regulations

Waterfront Properties – Highlighting water frontage, views, access to boating, nearby marinas, and flood zones

Properties with Conservation Easements – Clearly outlining easement boundaries, restricted areas, and permitted uses

Hunting/Recreational Land – Showcasing terrain, game trails, water sources, bordering public lands, and access points

Properties with Historic Significance – Mapping historical features, nearby landmarks, and historical districts

Investment Properties – Illustrating proximity to rental markets, universities, employment centers, and other investment drivers

Rural Residential Properties – Displaying access to essential services (schools, hospitals, grocery stores), nearby towns, and natural amenities

Unique or “Destination” Properties – Highlighting surrounding attractions, accessibility, and overall experience (e.g., a vacation rental near a national park)
